name: Photography & Film
description: Full-bleed series and film pages for photographers, filmmakers and other visual creatives.
guidance: Only publish pictures and film you have the right to show. Get releases for identifiable people and permission for private property, credit collaborators, and check client agreements before showing commissioned or unreleased work.

heroSuggestions.title: Photographer and Filmmaker
heroSuggestions.summary: Photographer and filmmaker telling quiet, human stories through stills and short films, available for editorial, documentary and commissioned work.

seo.title: {name} — {title}
seo.description: {name}, {title}. Selected series, films and commissions, with details on how to enquire.
seo.aboutDescription: About {name}, {title}: the work, the approach and the clients and publications worked with.

summary.hint: What you were hired to make and where it appeared.

title.hint: The name of the series or film.

role.hint: For example Photographer, Director or Cinematographer.

org.label: Client or publication
org.hint: Only name a client you have permission to name.

period.hint: When it was made, for example 2023.

problem.label: The idea
problem.hint: What the series or film is about and why you made it. Plain text.

approach.label: How it was made
approach.hint: Where, with whom and on what. Plain text.

impact.label: Where it went
impact.hint: One line each, up to 8: publications, screenings, prizes.

heroImage.label: Cover picture
heroImage.hint: Shown full-bleed on the series grid and at the top of the series page. JPEG, PNG or WebP.

screenshots.label: Pictures in the series
screenshots.hint: Add pictures one at a time on the Images page. Each needs a description for people who cannot see it.

links.label: Films and links
links.hint: Link a film or a full set. Films are linked, never embedded: use the cover picture as the poster.

category.hint: A kind of work such as Landscape, Portrait or Documentary. Used by the filter on the series page.

credentialUrl.label: Link to the show or prize

url.label: Link to the film or recording
url.hint: http or https. Films are linked, not embedded.

quote.label: What they said
quote.hint: Plain text. Only with the person's permission.

authorTitle.label: Their role and publication or company

body.label: Entry text
body.hint: Markdown. Raw HTML is shown as text, not run.

cover.hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP. Shown at the top of the entry and when it is shared.

heading.label: Home page opening
heading.hint: The first thing visitors read, above your selected series. Plain text. Changes apply as soon as you save.

eyebrow.label: Role line
eyebrow.hint: For example your disciplines and where you work. Plain text.

heading.label: Key figures
heading.hint: Short facts such as years behind the camera or films screened. Only publish figures you can stand behind. Changes apply as soon as you save.

heading.label: Pages of your site
heading.hint: Choose which pages the site has, what the menu calls them and in which order. Hiding a page never deletes it. Changes apply as soon as you save.

heading.label: About you
heading.hint: Your story, how you work and what draws you to a subject. Changes apply as soon as you save.

valueProps.label: Beliefs
valueProps.hint: Short statements about how you work, shown above the text.

heading.label: Back up and restore your portfolio
heading.hint: Keep your portfolio in one file, or restore one. You see what would change first, and nothing is ever removed.

exportHeading.label: Save a copy
exportHeading.hint: One file with your details and every entry, including unpublished ones. Pictures you uploaded are listed, not included.

importHeading.label: Restore from a file
importHeading.hint: Each entry in the file is matched to one of yours by its name or title: a match is updated, anything else is added.

layout.footerNote: Photography and film portfolio. Pictures are shown with permission.

home.workEmptyBody: Add the series and films you are proudest of. Lead with a strong cover picture, then tell the story behind it.
home.contactHeading: Planning a shoot or a film? Let's talk.
